title: Command body
statement: A command whose change neither the pattern's fixed part nor its settings can say (a move, a link with checks, a refusal no rule states) MUST be written by hand against this contract: it changes its one aggregate, loaded whole, refuses with every reason and changes nothing when it refuses, and holds the aggregate to its rules before it saves.

title: Aggregate rules
statement: Each aggregate's rules MUST check every instance they are given against the aggregate's invariants and return every problem, each named as its refusal names it, changing nothing.

title: Instance mapping
statement: Each aggregate MUST say how its kinds sit in an instance (its shape), build each instance whole from its own stored records and give back exactly those records, so that its loading, saving and pattern commands are derived from it.

title: Query answer
statement: Each query MUST answer from what its read model's reader gives it alone, and refuse with a reason when its input names nothing the reader holds.

title: Editor
statement: Each aggregate's editor MUST draw its forms from its commands' derived fields, built from the shared inputs, and add only what an input cannot say: labels, long text and choices.

title: Record body
statement: Each aggregate's record view MUST show, below the shared title, kind and links, what its own view requirements ask of its record, reading only through its aggregate's queries.
